'''Arran Flekk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Flekk came from a long line of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who served the [[Queen/Legends|queens]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] for many generations. Flekk entered the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] at age seventeen and eventually rose to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. Flekk was highly decorated during his time in service and was eventually transferred to the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] ''[[Predator's Beak]]''. However, it crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]] and was left with no functioning engines of communication systems, while Flekk and [[Vor Harkass]] were the only survivors. After they had been there over a month, they encountered the surviving crew of a crashed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and they joined forces. They soon after entered the [[Fornayh's fortress|fortress]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]], where they confronted his reawakened [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]].

==Behind the scenes==
Arran Flekk featured in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] scenario ''[[Shadows in the Force]]'' and has no canonical gender, as that is established by the player.
